insights.one_liner: European refiner and renewable fuels producer headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with a data internship in South Holland that needs no Dutch.

culture.text: Staff mostly studied business, economics, chemical engineering and supply chain, often at Swedish universities like Chalmers, KTH and Uppsala.
Large group: LinkedIn lists it at 1,001-5,000 employees, with operations, engineering and finance as the main functions.
Formed by combining VARO Energy and Preem; runs six manufacturing hubs and has access to over 120 terminals across 33 countries.

open.text: Not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one open job here, a data and analytics internship in South Holland, does not require Dutch; it drew 63 LinkedIn applicants on average.

growth.text: Completed the acquisition of Sunpine, described as the world's largest raw tall oil bio-refinery.
Calls itself Europe's third-largest independent refiner and second-largest renewable fuels producer, and fully owns EV charging developer elexon.

worth_knowing.text: Its CEO said Europe's defence spending is propping up a shrinking refining sector.
